'''Arie Lev Gruzman''' ({{langx|he|אריה גרוזמן}}; born 3 October 1970) is a professor of chemistry at [[Bar Ilan University]] specializing in [[Medicinal Chemistry]].

==Biography==
Arie Lev Gruzman<ref name="BIU">{{Cite web |title=Gruzman Arie-Lev {{!}} Department of Chemistry |url=https://ch.biu.ac.il/gruzman |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=ch.biu.ac.il}}</ref> (1970) was born in Gorky (nowadays [[Nizhniy Novgorod]]), Russia.  He graduated (1988) from {{ill|First Gorky Nursing College|ru|Нижегородский медицинский базовый колледж|vertical-align=sup}}<ref>Nowadays, ({{langx|ru|:Нижегородский медицинский базовый колледж}})</ref> ([[Latin honors#Types|Summa cum Laude]]) as a [[Nursing|practical nurse]]. At the same year, he enrolled at the Pediatric faculty of Gorky Academy for Medicine (nowadays, [[Privolzhsky Research Medical University]]). After two and a half years, he interrupted his education towards [[Doctor of Medicine|M.D.]] and [[Aliyah|repatriated to Israel]] in 1991. He obtained his B.Sc. in [[Medicinal chemistry]] from [[Bar-Ilan University]] (1995) and a Ph.D. (summa cum laude) from the School of Pharmacy,<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://medicine.ekmd.huji.ac.il/schools/pharmacy/En/home/Pages/default.aspx |title=School of Pharmacy, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem |access-date=2018-11-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160311045143/https://medicine.ekmd.huji.ac.il/schools/pharmacy/En/home/Pages/default.aspx |archive-date=2016-03-11 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Faculty of Medicine, at [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem|the Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] under the supervision of Prof. Shlomo Sasson and  Prof. Jehoshua Katzehendler. After a military service in the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]], he was a postdoctoral researcher (2004–2007) at the Department of Physiology, [[UCSF School of Medicine|University of California, San Francisco School of Medicine (UCSF)]] and at [[California Pacific Medical Center|California Pacific Medical Center (CPMC)]] at [[San Francisco]], under the supervision of Prof. Vishvanath Lingappa.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Home |url=https://the-asci.org/controllers/asci/DirectoryController.php?action=profile&entryId=159600 |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=The American Society for Clinical Investigation |language=en-US}}</ref> After returning to Israel, he worked as a head of a project (development of new [[Anti-diabetic medication|antidiabetic drug]]) at [[Yissum Research Development Company of the Hebrew University]]. Since 2009 he is a faculty member in the department of chemistry at [[Bar-Ilan University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Chemistry {{!}} Bar-Ilan University |url=https://ch.biu.ac.il/ |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=ch.biu.ac.il}}</ref> Gruzman served as a vice-president of the Medicinal Chemistry Section of the Israel Chemical Society MCS-ICS (2011–2015).<ref>{{Cite web |last=mcs-ics.org.il |title=Home :: MCS Israel Chemical Society |url=http://www.mcs-ics.org.il/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220407073512/http://www.mcs-ics.org.il/ |archive-date=2022-04-07 |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=www.mcs-ics.org.il}}</ref> He is also one of the founders of the [[Startup company|startup]] [[drug development]] company “AltA-ZuZ”.

== Scientific interests and publications ==
His research areas of interest<ref name=BIU /><ref name=lab>[https://www.gruzman-lab.com/ Prof. Gruzman's lab - website]</ref> include [[organic synthesis]], [[medicinal chemistry]], [[Peptide synthesis|peptide chemistry]], [[analytical chemistry]], [[pharmacology]], [[pharmacokinetics]] studies, [[in vitro]] and [[in vivo]] [[Drug discovery|drug candidate testing]], [[nanotechnology]], [[Molecular modelling|molecular computer-aided modeling]], and basic [[biochemistry]]. His current research<ref>[https://www.gruzman-lab.com/publications Prof. Arie-Lev Gruzman - List of Publications]</ref> focuses on [[Drug development|developing of new drugs]] for the treatment of [[insulin]] dependent [[diabetes mellitus]] (IDDM, [[Diabetes mellitus type 1|Type 1 diabetes]])<ref name="MunderIsrael2017">{{cite journal|last1=Munder|first1=Anna|last2=Israel|first2=Liron He was elected as Israeli Representative of the Chemistry and Human Health, Division of [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC)]] for the term 2022–2023.
